findings.description: The only server-side lines in locked sneak rows, 'ATD_BRIDGE DENIAL_INTENT_DISCOVERED ability=sneak', are produced when the client mod reports a denial intent over the bridge, not by the server guard NativeMovementAgent.sneak (setShiftKeyDown). The effect oracle is the client 'crouching' flag. The rows therefore prove the end-to-end lock with the real client, but no row shows the server-side setShiftKeyDown guard firing or a server-side pose probe.
